        """

def minion_publish(self, clear_load):
        """
        Publish a command initiated from a minion, this method executes minion
        restrictions so that the minion publication will only work if it is
        enabled in the config.

        The configuration on the master allows minions to be matched to
        salt functions, so the minions can only publish allowed salt functions

        The config will look like this:

        .. code-block:: bash

            peer:
                .*:
                    - .*

        This configuration will enable all minions to execute all commands.
        peer:

        .. code-block:: bash

            foo.example.com:
                - test.*

        The above configuration will only allow the minion foo.example.com to
        execute commands from the test module.

        :param dict clear_load: The minion payload
        """
        import re

        minion_id = clear_load.get('minion_id')
        func = clear_load.get('fun')

        if not minion_id or not func:
            return False

        peer_config = self.config.get('peer', {})

        allowed = False
        for pattern, functions in peer_config.items():
            if re.match(pattern, minion_id):
                for func_pattern in functions:
                    if re.match(func_pattern, func):
                        allowed = True
                        break
            if allowed:
                break

        if allowed:
            self.publish(clear_load)
            return True

        return False
